{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Momentum", "construction": "Calculate the change in research and development expenses over the past year, scaled by total assets, and then rank stocks based on this change", "rationale": "Firms with increasing R&D expenditures may be more likely to innovate and experience future growth, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Fund Underfunding", "construction": "Calculate the difference between the projected benefit obligation and the fair value of plan assets for pension funds, scaled by total assets, using data from the footnotes of 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with underfunded pension plans may face higher future liabilities, reducing expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the percentage of total sales derived from the top 5 customers, using data from the 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with high customer concentration may be more vulnerable to losses if a major customer defaults or switches to a competitor", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability Exposure", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of environmental liabilities to total assets, using data from the footnotes of 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities may face future costs and reputational damage, reducing expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Unionization Rate", "construction": "Calculate the percentage of employees that are unionized, using data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics and company filings", "rationale": "Firms with high unionization rates may face higher labor costs and reduced flexibility, reducing expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director and Officer Stock Ownership Dispersion", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of stock ownership among directors and officers, using data from proxy statements", "rationale": "Firms with dispersed ownership among insiders may have less aligned incentives, reducing expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "Calculate the number of different suppliers used by the firm, scaled by total assets, using data from 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with complex supply chains may be more vulnerable to disruptions and logistics issues, reducing expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Turnover Rate", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of employee turnover to total employees, using data from company filings and industry reports", "rationale": "Firms with high employee turnover rates may face higher recruitment and training costs, reducing expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Litigation Frequency", "construction": "Calculate the number of lawsuits filed against the firm over the past year, scaled by total assets, using data from court filings and company reports", "rationale": "Firms with frequent litigation may face higher legal costs and reputational damage, reducing expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Recalls", "construction": "Calculate the number of product recalls issued by the firm over the past year, scaled by total sales, using data from company reports and regulatory filings", "rationale": "Firms with frequent product recalls may face higher costs and reputational damage, reducing expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
